name: Suzhou Fengbei Biotech Stock Co.
summary: Suzhou Fengbei Biotech Stock Co., Ltd. centers its operations around the extensive repurposing of waste oil resources, also maintaining a division for oleochemicals. The company predominantly manufactures valuable products derived from recycled oils and fats. Its offerings include bio-based materials, biofuels, DD oil, and various fatty acids. This enterprise, based in Suzhou, China, commenced its activities on July 25, 2014.
